| **[Transferring the Intelligence of VLMs to Robotic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22966)** [📄](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.22966) | 2026-09-19 | <details><summary>📄 摘要</summary><p>Humans can seamlessly adapt to both physical and digital worlds, suggesting that while a digital-to-real gap exists in embodiment, environment and task, human intelligence itself may transfer across this gap. This naturally raises a fundamental question: can the intelligence of vision-language models (VLMs) similarly generalize from the digital world to the physical world for robotic control? We investigate this question through RoboDawn, a human-intuitive interface that exposes robotic control to an agentic VLM through a compact set of discrete translation, rotation, and gripper commands.
